verdict.rationale: Baseten's evidence shows it enables external coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Pi) to connect to Baseten via Model APIs or lets those agents manage a Baseten workspace via MCP/skill install (baseten-docs-5, baseten-docs-22, baseten-docs-41) — but this is the reverse of the story: it's about other agents controlling Baseten, not a built-in assistant living inside Baseten's own console to which a user delegates tasks. No evidence of a native in-product assistant/chat feature for managing deployments, training, or workspace tasks.
